baselines.title: Bundle Trend Baseline
baselines.failureMode: Tracked logical assets fail on gzip growth over 5% or 10,240 bytes, and new tracked assets over 10,240 gzip bytes block until reviewed.
baselines.review: Run after npm run build, inspect dist/reports/bundle-report.md, then commit tests/bundle-baseline.json.

baselines.title: Generated Client OpenAPI Snapshot
baselines.failureMode: The typed client snapshot must not lag behind the live LSAT backend OpenAPI surface.
baselines.review: Regenerate after backend contract changes and review both the JSON snapshot and generated TypeScript diff.

baselines.title: Direct Sidecar Fetch Inventory Baseline
baselines.failureMode: New direct localhost:8100 fetch callers outside approved adapters fail until routed through an adapter or explicitly baselined.
baselines.review: Prefer removing resolved entries; only add new entries after deferring an adapter migration intentionally.

baselines.title: LSAT Backend OpenAPI Baseline
baselines.failureMode: Removed paths, methods, or 2xx response fields are treated as breaking contract drift.
baselines.review: Refresh only after backend route changes and generated client updates are reviewed together.

baselines.title: LSAT Typed Route Schema Baseline
baselines.failureMode: Host-consumed typed routes may add fields, but may not silently drop fields promised by the baseline.
baselines.review: Refresh only with the backend contract and host generated-client diff.

baselines.title: Prompt Regression Fixture
baselines.failureMode: Prompt hashes and required substrings must match the committed host and backend prompt fixture.
baselines.review: Refresh host and backend prompt cases in one fixture change; run the host and backend prompt floor checks before committing.

baselines.title: RAG Retrieval Fixtures
baselines.failureMode: Recall, precision, MRR, and nDCG must stay at or above the seeded fixture floor.
baselines.review: Hand-edit corpus and relevance judgments, then reseed floors only with a documented retrieval tradeoff or improvement.

baselines.title: Route Performance Baseline
baselines.failureMode: Cold and warm route metrics must stay within the committed navigation/FCP/LCP/CLS/TBT budgets.
baselines.review: Refresh only after stable CI evidence and keep dist/reports/perf-regression.json with the review notes.

baselines.title: Source Grounded Answer Fixture
baselines.failureMode: Grounded CFA and LSAT answers must cite entailed chunks, and unsupported cross-domain answers must be rejected.
baselines.review: Hand-edit fixture cases and chunks together; keep unsupported negative cases in the same fixture.

baselines.title: Visual Regression PNG Baselines
baselines.failureMode: Missing route/theme/viewport PNG baselines fail closed inside visual regression unless update mode is explicit.
baselines.review: Review dist/reports/visual screenshots and diffs before approving the Linux baseline cache refresh.
